name: Salnotes Dioko
pros: Planar performance at a very accessible price
Good bass extension and midrange naturalness for the price
cons: Can be power hungry — benefits from a dongle or DAP
Fit can be problematic for smaller ears due to shell shape
Treble can become splashy on some tracks
insight: Dioko was 7Hz and Crinacle’s attempt to bring planar technology even further down in price after the success of the Timeless. At around $90–100 it offered a large 14.6mm planar driver, attractive sapphire-coated glass faceplates, and a tuning aimed at natural balance. Reviewers generally praised the value and the fact that it gave many listeners their first real taste of planar speed and resolution without spending Timeless money.
